scope: FedCPDP standalone, paper-style 30-project LOPO; NOT the previous cross-family-only RQ2 or MSMDA support/query task
target: All target records; no target labels during training/selection; project-wise target feature normalization is transductive
source_split: Fixed split seed 20261110; first legal two-class fold among five stratified group folds for validation (~20%), others training (~80%); groups are identical complete input feature rows. Same splits across model seeds. No public/attack reserve in this standalone run.
duplicate_policy: Preserve raw files. In each fold remove source records with features identical to target within identical schema; preserve conflicting source labels but group identical features for splitting. Save indices.
aggregation: Author hybrid rule; replace training loss input by unweighted held-out BCE of local model before update perturbation

thresholds.study_primary: Grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.025; maximize source-project macro MCC, tie higher macro Recall then lower threshold
thresholds.paper_supplement: Same grid; pooled source-validation F1, tie lower threshold

effort: Probability / raw LOC; stable row-ID tie break; budgets 5,10,20,40%; linear interpolation; truncated Popt area. Any invalid target LOC -> all effort metrics N/A for this project.
ensemble: Mean probability of three independent models; thresholds selected from validation records held out by all three; ensemble is NOT an additional independent repetition
deviations_and_limits: Author CSV release counts differ from paper table; no claim to exact numerical reproduction
80/20 validation and fixed split seed are implementation choices not specified in paper
Source target-duplicate exclusion and group splits are leakage controls added for this run
Native source loader excludes loc but not every alternative LOC field; preserve author feature selection and extract effort separately
Author core uses an approximate focal-loss gradient and partial alignment backprop; unchanged and explicitly not a rederivation of paper equations
Author Python hash used with PYTHONHASHSEED=0; environment frozen; not a portable hash guarantee
C=1 and sigma=0.1 are upstream defaults; no verified total epsilon/delta; auxiliary statistics are not fully protected
Noise enabled as native privacy mechanism; no additional privacy grid or RQ3 experiment
FedCPDP all-other-project LOPO includes same-family sources, differing from earlier RQ2 cross-family-only proposal
